description: MaxRows bounds what a query may return, never what it may look at. The namespace holds more documents than maxRows; a query over it must answer from every document, and a result larger than maxRows is an error, not a prefix. Read by go/kdb/sql/result_bound_fixture_test.go and kdb-sql's jvmTest ResultBoundFixtureTest; both trees must agree on every case.
document: {"name":"n%03d","rank":%d}  (name and rank both from the 0-based index, name zero-padded to 3 digits)

cases.name: selective equality past the bound
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM t WHERE name = 'n049'

cases.name: range matching only late documents
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM t WHERE rank >= 45 ORDER BY name

cases.name: filtered COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE rank >= 10

cases.name: filtered overflow is an error
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM t WHERE rank >= 5

cases.name: ordered overflow is an error
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM t ORDER BY name

cases.name: LIMIT and OFFSET reaching past the bound
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM t LIMIT 5 OFFSET 40

cases.name: ORDER BY DESC with LIMIT
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM t ORDER BY name DESC LIMIT 3

cases.name: LIMIT larger than the bound is still an overflow
grouped result within the bound
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE rank < 20
